selection_basis: Four task0/init20 cases were fixed for smoke before the discovery matrix; no outcome-based case selection.
inputs: Existing first_policy_observation.npz plus, when required, exact replay of recorded Full actions to reconstruct subsequent request observations. Every reconstructed request must match the recorded input SHA256; mismatched reconstructions are technical failures, not silently accepted approximate input banks.

primary_measurement.name: same_observation_warm_service_cost
primary_measurement.state: Reset at case boundaries; full forces every request Full, pure draft has no Full or verify. Use the identical input/noise bank in each source and route.
primary_measurement.warmup: 20 calls per case/prompt/source/route, then inspect the last two 10-call windows. Any further graph construction or large latency shift remains cold and is reported; do not silently reclassify it as warm.
primary_measurement.order: Within the same allocated GPU, run target-fixed conditions sequentially; a second pass reverses source order. Report each pass and the pooled result.
primary_measurement.limitation: Pure draft and Full request-cost comparison only. This does not measure complete FLASH throughput or acceptance.

secondary_measurement.name: one_draft_after_full_shadow_verification
secondary_measurement.input_requirement: Adjacent real Full trajectory requests, reconstructed with exact SHA256 agreement.
secondary_measurement.state: For each pair reset policy, run the preceding observation with its original Full noise, then run one native FLASH draft+verify on the next observation using the actual preceding Full execution length. Reset before the next pair. This creates a common authentic Full cache and gripper anchor across source heads.
secondary_measurement.warmup: Warm every target prompt/source/route shape before measured pairs; report anchor-Full and draft+verify calls separately.
secondary_measurement.limitation: Conditional shadow acceptance after one Full anchor; not PF2 steady-state FLASH, not closed-loop success, not end-to-end speedup.

steady_state_flash_evidence: Use actual matched closed-loop discovery and held-out init21-24 runs. Their native multi-round cache, acceptance, periodic Full, rejection fallback and real trajectories are authoritative. A static first-observation repetition or forced Full-trajectory replay cannot establish closed-loop steady-state acceptance once accepted actions differ.
stopping_rule: Run the fixed cases and measurement counts. No repeated runs to improve a scientific success/failure or acceptance result. Technical bank reconstruction failures are diagnosed separately. No changes to frozen run.py/server.py/client.py/common.py.
